skidbuffer.summary: Valid/ready skid buffer: a one-entry side register (r_data/r_valid) captures input when output stalls, with optional registered output stage.

blocks.name: skid_register
blocks.description: One-entry overflow buffer capturing input while downstream stalls.

anchors.name: LOGIC.r_valid
anchors.why: Skid-full flag; set when input accepted while output stalled, deasserts o_ready, selects r_data to output.

anchors.name: LOGIC.r_data
anchors.why: One-entry skid register holding input data while downstream is stalled.

anchors.name: w_data
anchors.why: Debug/formal view of skid register contents r_data.

blocks.name: output_stage
blocks.description: Registered output valid/data, muxing skid data or fresh input.

anchors.name: o_valid
anchors.why: Downstream valid, registered from i_valid or skid-full flag.

anchors.name: o_data
anchors.why: Output payload register, chooses r_data when skid full else i_data.

anchors.name: i_ready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; clears skid flag and advances output register.

blocks.name: input_handshake
blocks.description: Upstream valid/ready/data interface.

anchors.name: i_valid
anchors.why: Upstream valid; with o_ready accepts data into skid or output register.

anchors.name: o_ready
anchors.why: Upstream ready, inverse of skid-full flag r_valid.

anchors.name: i_data
anchors.why: Incoming payload loaded into r_data or directly into o_data.

sfifo.summary: Synchronous FIFO built on a circular memory array with write/read address pointers, an occupancy counter deriving full, and a registered empty flag.

blocks.name: fifo_memory
blocks.description: Circular data array holding queued words.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO memory array written at wr_addr, read asynchronously at rd_addr.

blocks.name: write_side
blocks.description: Qualifies write requests and advances the write pointer into mem.

anchors.name: w_wr
anchors.why: Qualified write enable: advances wr_addr, writes mem, updates fill.

anchors.name: wr_addr
anchors.why: Write pointer, increments on accepted write, addresses mem.

blocks.name: read_side
blocks.description: Qualifies read requests and advances the read pointer driving o_data.

anchors.name: w_rd
anchors.why: Qualified read enable: advances rd_addr, updates fill and empty.

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Read pointer, increments on accepted read, addresses mem.

blocks.name: occupancy_flags
blocks.description: Fill counter and derived full/empty flags.

anchors.name: o_fill
anchors.why: Occupancy count, +1 on write, -1 on read; MSB gives full.

anchors.name: o_full
anchors.why: Full indication from fill MSB; blocks writes.

anchors.name: o_empty
anchors.why: Empty indication from r_empty; blocks reads.

anchors.name: r_empty
anchors.why: Registered empty flag updated from fill on read/write.

ungrouped_anchors.name: i_wr
ungrouped_anchors.why: Write request; qualified by not-full to push i_data.

ungrouped_anchors.name: i_data
ungrouped_anchors.why: Write data payload stored into mem.

ungrouped_anchors.name: i_rd
ungrouped_anchors.why: Read request from consumer; qualified by not-empty to pop.

ungrouped_anchors.name: o_data
ungrouped_anchors.why: Read data output taken from mem at rd_addr.

aximwr2wbsp.summary: AXI4 write-slave to Wishbone bridge: skid-buffered AW/W channels feed a burst unwinder issuing pipelined Wishbone writes, while ack counters and BID/error FIFOs build AXI B responses.

blocks.name: AXI input skid buffers
blocks.description: Skid buffers registering AW and W channels before burst processing

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI write address valid into AW skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: AXI AW ready from skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: AXI burst start address into AW skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: AXI write data valid into W skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: AXI W ready from skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: AXI write data into W skid buffer

anchors.name: skid_awvalid
anchors.why: Buffered AW valid feeding burst acceptance

anchors.name: skid_wvalid
anchors.why: Buffered W valid driving strobes and address advance

anchors.name: skid_wready
anchors.why: Ready to W skid buffer when Wishbone not stalled

anchors.name: skid_awready
anchors.why: Idle-between-bursts flag; low while a burst is being unwound

blocks.name: Burst unwinder
blocks.description: Accepts bursts, holds burst parameters and steps the address per beat

anchors.name: accept_write_burst
anchors.why: Accepts new AW burst: latches burst regs, starts wb cycle, pushes ack FIFO

anchors.name: axi_waddr
anchors.why: Current burst address, loaded at accept and advanced per beat

anchors.name: next_addr
anchors.why: Next burst address computed by axi_addr instance

anchors.name: total_fifo_full
anchors.why: Full flag preventing new burst acceptance

blocks.name: Wishbone master
blocks.description: Issues pipelined Wishbone writes with cyc/stb, data, select

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Wishbone cycle held from burst accept until last ack or error

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: Wishbone strobe issuing one write per accepted W beat

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: Wishbone word address taken from burst address register

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone write data registered from skid W data

anchors.name: o_wb_sel
anchors.why: Wishbone byte select from skid write strobes

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: Wishbone stall back-pressure gating strobe and W acceptance

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone ack decrementing ack counters and ending cycle

anchors.name: i_wb_err
anchors.why: Wishbone bus error; drops cycle, sets err_state, recorded in error FIFO

blocks.name: Ack tracking
blocks.description: Counters and burst-length FIFO tracking outstanding Wishbone acks per burst

anchors.name: acks_expected
anchors.why: Outstanding Wishbone acks counter; blocks ID-changing bursts

anchors.name: last_ack
anchors.why: Indicates next ack is the final one, ending wb cycle

anchors.name: total_fifo_fill
anchors.why: Outstanding bursts occupancy; full blocks acceptance, compared for error recovery

anchors.name: read_ack_fifo
anchors.why: Pops burst length from ack FIFO when current burst acks done

anchors.name: acklen
anchors.why: Acks remaining in current burst, reloaded from ack FIFO

anchors.name: ack_last
anchors.why: Marks final ack of burst, triggers error FIFO write

anchors.name: ack_empty
anchors.why: No burst currently tracked in ack counter

anchors.name: ack_err
anchors.why: Accumulated error status of current burst written to error FIFO

blocks.name: Write response
blocks.description: BID and error FIFOs producing AXI B responses; error recovery state

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid when BID and error FIFOs both non-empty

anchors.name: S_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: AXI B ready pops BID/error FIFOs and decrements fills

anchors.name: S_AXI_BID
anchors.why: Response ID read from BID FIFO

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Response code; bit1 from error FIFO

anchors.name: err_state
anchors.why: Error-recovery flag after wb error; blocks bursts and drains FIFOs

anchors.name: err_fifo_write
anchors.why: Pushes per-burst error result into error FIFO

aximrd2wbsp.summary: AXI4 read-to-Wishbone bridge: skid-buffered AR requests issue pipelined Wishbone strobes with a burst address generator, while ID/last and data/error FIFOs return R beats, with error-state flushing.

blocks.name: AR request skid buffer
blocks.description: Buffers AXI read requests until accept_request.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI read request valid into the AR skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: AR ready from skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARID
anchors.why: AXI read transaction ID, buffered and returned on RID.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: AXI burst start address loaded into axi_addr.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARLEN
anchors.why: Burst length setting number of Wishbone strobes.

anchors.name: skid_arvalid
anchors.why: Buffered request valid feeding accept_request.

blocks.name: Wishbone master control
blocks.description: Issues burst strobes, tracks outstanding acks, throttling and error state.

anchors.name: accept_request
anchors.why: Accepts a buffered AR request; loads burst regs, starts cycle, counts acks.

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Wishbone bus cycle, raised on accept, dropped on last ack or error.

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: Wishbone strobe per beat, throttled by FIFO near-full and stall.

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: Wishbone stall; holds strobe and address advance.

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone ack; pushes read data into resp FIFO and ends cycle.

anchors.name: i_wb_err
anchors.why: Wishbone bus error; aborts cycle and enters err_state.

anchors.name: err_state
anchors.why: Error flush mode: blocks requests, drains ID FIFO returning error responses.

anchors.name: stblen
anchors.why: Remaining strobes in current burst, decremented per issued beat.

anchors.name: last_stb
anchors.why: Marks final strobe of burst; stored as RLAST in ID FIFO.

anchors.name: midissue
anchors.why: Burst issue in progress; blocks new requests and restarts strobes.

anchors.name: last_ack
anchors.why: Next ack ends the bus cycle; drops o_wb_cyc.

anchors.name: acks_expected
anchors.why: Outstanding acknowledgements counter used to compute last_ack.

anchors.name: fifo_nearfull
anchors.why: ID FIFO near-full flag throttling o_wb_stb.

anchors.name: wb_empty
anchors.why: No outstanding Wishbone requests; allows request with different ID.

blocks.name: Burst address generator
blocks.description: Holds burst parameters and steps the address per accepted strobe.

anchors.name: axi_addr
anchors.why: Burst address register, loaded on accept and advanced by next_addr.

anchors.name: next_addr
anchors.why: Next burst address computed by axi_addr child.

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: Wishbone word address taken from axi_addr.

anchors.name: o_wb_sel
anchors.why: Wishbone byte select from size strobe shifted by address LSBs.

anchors.name: axi_strb
anchors.why: Byte strobe pattern from ARSIZE held for the burst.

anchors.name: axi_id
anchors.why: ID of active burst, written into ID FIFO per beat.

blocks.name: Response FIFOs
blocks.description: ID/last FIFO and data/error FIFO jointly produce the AXI R channel.

anchors.name: lastid_fifo_wr
anchors.why: Pushes {id,last} per issued strobe; decrements stblen.

anchors.name: lastid_fifo_full
anchors.why: ID FIFO full; blocks strobe issue.

anchors.name: lastid_fifo_empty
anchors.why: ID FIFO empty; ends err_state and gates error responses.

anchors.name: lastid_fifo_fill
anchors.why: ID FIFO occupancy used for near-full and wb_empty.

anchors.name: resp_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Response FIFO empty; RVALID asserted when not empty.

anchors.name: read_data
anchors.why: Endian-adjusted Wishbone data pushed into response FIFO.

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone read data, optionally byte-swapped into read_data.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid when response FIFO non-empty or error flush.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: R ready; pops both FIFOs and resumes stalled strobes.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RID
anchors.why: Returned ID from ID FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data from response FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RLAST
anchors.why: Burst last flag from ID FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RRESP
anchors.why: Read response, SLVERR on bus error or error flush.

wbarbiter.summary: Two-master Wishbone arbiter: a 1-bit owner register (alternating scheme) muxes A or B request signals onto the shared bus and routes ack/stall/err back to the owner.

blocks.name: Arbiter
blocks.description: Alternating grant logic choosing owner from A/B cyc and stb requests.

anchors.name: r_a_owner
anchors.why: Grant bit selecting master A or B; steers all output muxes and return-path gating.

anchors.name: ALT.last_owner
anchors.why: Remembers last bus owner so idle grant alternates between masters.

anchors.name: i_a_cyc
anchors.why: Master A bus request; drives grant decisions and o_cyc.

anchors.name: i_b_cyc
anchors.why: Master B bus request; drives grant decisions and o_cyc.

blocks.name: Request mux
blocks.description: Muxes owning master's cyc/stb/we/adr/dat/sel onto shared bus.

anchors.name: o_cyc
anchors.why: Arbitrated bus-cycle output, copy of owner's cyc line.

anchors.name: o_stb
anchors.why: Arbitrated strobe output from owning master.

anchors.name: o_we
anchors.why: Muxed write-enable command from owning master.

anchors.name: o_adr
anchors.why: Muxed address from owning master to the shared bus.

anchors.name: o_dat
anchors.why: Muxed write data from owning master to shared bus.

anchors.name: o_sel
anchors.why: Muxed byte-select lanes from owning master.

blocks.name: Response router
blocks.description: Routes ack/stall/err from slave back to the owning master only.

anchors.name: i_ack
anchors.why: Slave acknowledge routed back only to the owning master.

anchors.name: i_stall
anchors.why: Slave stall forwarded to owner; non-owner always stalled.

anchors.name: o_a_ack
anchors.why: Acknowledge to master A, gated by ownership.

anchors.name: o_b_ack
anchors.why: Acknowledge to master B, gated by ownership.

anchors.name: o_a_stall
anchors.why: Stall to master A; forced high when A lacks the bus.

anchors.name: o_b_stall
anchors.why: Stall to master B; forced high when B lacks the bus.

axim2wbsp.summary: AXI4 slave to Wishbone master bridge: separate write and read converter children each drive a Wishbone master port, merged onto one pipelined Wishbone bus by a two-master arbiter.

blocks.name: AXI write converter
blocks.description: aximwr2wbsp turns AXI write bursts into Wishbone writes and B responses.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI write address request into write converter.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: AXI write data into write converter.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI write response valid from write converter.

anchors.name: w_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Write converter Wishbone cycle request into arbiter master B.

anchors.name: w_wb_addr
anchors.why: Write converter Wishbone address into arbiter.

anchors.name: w_wb_data
anchors.why: Write converter Wishbone data into arbiter.

anchors.name: w_wb_ack
anchors.why: Arbiter-routed ack to write converter.

blocks.name: AXI read converter
blocks.description: aximrd2wbsp turns AXI read bursts into Wishbone reads and R beats.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI read address request into read converter.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: AXI read data returned by read converter.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI read beat valid from read converter.

anchors.name: r_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Read converter Wishbone cycle request into arbiter master A.

anchors.name: r_wb_addr
anchors.why: Read converter Wishbone address into arbiter.

anchors.name: r_wb_ack
anchors.why: Arbiter-routed ack to read converter.

blocks.name: Wishbone read/write arbiter
blocks.description: wbarbiter grants shared Wishbone bus to read or write converter.

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Shared Wishbone bus cycle output driven by the read/write arbiter.

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: Wishbone address muxed from read or write converter.

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: Wishbone strobe for each pipelined request beat.

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone write data from the write converter via arbiter.

anchors.name: o_wb_we
anchors.why: Wishbone write enable, set by owning master.

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone read data fed directly to the read converter.

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone acknowledge routed back to owning converter.

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: Wishbone stall routed back to owning converter.
